summary: For every future UI or frontend change in well-ambient, load project Impeccable, design-taste-frontend, and finesse-ui, record their shared direction before editing, stop if any gate is missing, then run Impeccable detection and authenticated browser validation after implementation.

request: Align every delivery owner and project dropdown with Decision Dashboard and fix the three-person Task Table regression.
outcome: Added one authenticated owner/project directory, migrated all delivery dropdown consumers, retained historical row facts without candidate pollution, and normalized nullable project-config arrays.
decisions: RBAC groups authorize access but never define delivery owners
sync_users is primary and custom-JQL assignees are fallback-only
validation: authenticated multi-route desktop and narrow browser checks
